correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact infection arrival is sum of d i.i.d. Exp(λ) stages, immunization completion sum h i.i.d. Exp(μ). Interleaved event streams give the negative-binomial race (1-q)^h Σ_{j<d}C(h+j-1,j)q^j; strict descendants N_d=Σ_{i=1}^{H-d}b^i. For w_j=C(h+j-1,j)q^j the ratios w_(j+1)/w_j=q(h+j)/(j+1) decrease, implying strict log-concavity of partial sums S_d. The geometric descendant sequence N_d is strictly log-concave too, so W_d has decreasing adjacent ratios, allowing a unique optimum or two adjacent tied depths. Adjacent ratio S_{d+1}/S_d strictly increases with q from 1 to 1+h/d, so crossings exist exactly at the displayed strict inequality; the monotone depth-ratio order makes them an initial segment with increasing q_d. Since N_d/N_{d+1}>b, h=1 never crosses, and for h=2 only b=2,d=1 can cross, with Q_H as claimed. Recomputed exact 2,4,2,3/4 example (7/8,15/16,67/128). Independent rational race-DP checks passed for 1920 b,H,h,q cases; proof applies to all positive λ,μ.

final_claim: On complete rooted b-ary SI trees (b≥2,H≥2) under one-target Erlang(h,μ) vaccine and Exp(λ) edge transmission, the expected strict-descendant protection W_d=N_d(1-q)^h Σ_{j=0}^{d-1}binom(h+j-1,j)q^j, q=λ/(λ+μ), is strictly log-concave in 1≤d≤H-1. Crossing from d to d+1 occurs iff N_d/N_{d+1}<1+h/d, at unique ordered q_d; h=1 always optimal depth1, h=2 depth2 only on binary trees H≥4 above Q_H=2^{H-2}/(2^{H-1}-2).
limitations: Single initially infected root and single time-zero vaccine, homogeneous independent exponential SI edges, i.i.d. Erlang maturation stages, complete finite b-ary trees.
